title: A village at your fingertips
subtitle: Choose a place. Shape its work. See the season change.

ui.paid: Materials paid once · crews work each season
ui.refund: Unused materials returned: {wood} timber, {blanks} prepared sets
ui.maintenance: One adult and one timber repair the weakest enabled place when allocated.
ui.access_note: One adult and one timber each season support the outer connection.
ui.inspect_note: Observation records knowledge. It creates no supplies or completed work.
ui.growth_note: Choose a route. Cards show real prerequisites and competing uses of the same ground.
ui.new_note: 30 residents · 100 provisions · 30 timber. Living rules; incidents remain an explicit choice.
ui.overwrite: Start a new village? Your saved village stays untouched until you choose Save.
ui.legacy: This save retains its existing rules. Adopt later chapters from the detailed ledger when ready.
ui.incident_note: Adds two bounded incidents to this living save. First guaranteed warning arrives after six seasons; no immediate damage.
ui.restriction_note: Fewer productive workers at the affected place; reduce exposure. Revisable before resolution.
ui.no_knowledge: Ask at the place to add available findings to your planning record.
ui.report_note: Actual results of the last resolved season.
ui.preview_note: Expected effects with current orders. Your later decisions can change them.
ui.help_keys: Click buildings or their icons · right-drag to look · WASD to move · Tab for mouse look
ui.model_empty: No existing building on this site. View the place in the village.

living_orders.label: Woodland
living_orders.detail: The same timber crew uses one finite woodland. Northern support reduces access losses.

living_orders.label: Prepare materials
living_orders.detail: Ordinary: 1 adult + 2 timber → 1 set. Shared: 2 adults + 3 timber + 2 working places; needs shared wood work.

living_orders.label: Support cooperation
living_orders.detail: Requires discovered complementary practice and actual shared sessions. Continuing support costs timber and labor.

living_orders.label: Observation focus
living_orders.detail: Coverage follows this place. Northern access needs its post and two ordinary watch adults.

living_orders.label: Watch practice
living_orders.detail: One additional adult trains with existing equipment; that adult cannot gather or build.

living_orders.label: Maintain equipment
living_orders.detail: One adult + one opening timber + one opening prepared set restore one missing kit, up to four.

chains.note: Keep short paths. Homes replace shared working ground; adapting the room restores space.
Keep central workspaces. Build and maintain the northern connection.
Food, storage and working space support further growth. These are complementary investments, not prerequisite steps.
Shelter enables equipment. The northern post is an independent choice of coverage.

lessons.title: Keep the village fed
lessons.body: Choose Stores, then its reserve objective. A higher target uses real gathering labor. The top strip shows supplies now and the expected seasonal change.

lessons.title: Choose an improvement
lessons.body: Click an illustrated improvement. Review timber, work and requirements, then commission it. Materials are paid once; work happens only when you resolve a season.

lessons.title: Leave hands for the work
lessons.body: Projects share adults with food, care, watch and preparation. The Work underway view lets you change crew limits, pause or cancel unfinished work.

lessons.title: Choose where to grow
lessons.body: Open the Growth guide. Compact homes consume central workspaces; outer homes need a maintained path. Inspect a card and visit its actual site before paying.

lessons.title: Prepare, resolve, recover
lessons.body: Maintain posts and equipment, then start the optional preparedness chapter. Warning and recovery appear at the affected place. Save whenever you want; looking around never advances time.
